evaluations.rationale: This allows early revealing of estimates, which is incompatible with participant stories requiring simultaneous reveal after all have estimated (PP-033) and related 'until last person' constraints (PP-034, PP-041).

evaluations.rationale: This presumes the draw remains open until a simultaneous reveal/completion; allowing a moderator to show estimates immediately (PP-009) would violate this 'until completion' constraint.
